blocks.text: Apartment interior design, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 54 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed a comprehensive project for a 54 m² apartment, including the interior design and technical documentation, the manufacture of custom furniture, a turnkey renovation, and final decorating.

The project covers all of the apartment’s main functional areas: the living room, bedroom, kitchen with well-planned interior fittings and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, and bathroom. Custom wardrobes, shelving, and storage systems are also integrated into the interior.

Custom furniture solutions were designed and manufactured for each area, tailored to the dimensions and features of the rooms. Designing the interior and furniture together makes it possible to use the apartment’s floor area efficiently, provide convenient storage, and maintain a unified visual style.

The project was delivered end to end — from developing the interior concept and technical documentation to the renovation work, the manufacture and installation of the furniture, and professional decorating. Before construction work began, a detailed cost estimate was prepared covering the renovation, finishing materials, custom furniture, and appliances.
The project is presented as photorealistic 3D visualizations showcasing the layout, interior, and furniture solutions for this 54 m² apartment.
